note: Muhlenberg County (KY) publishes no queryable zoning district service. Zoning for Central City, Greenville and Powderly exists only as unofficial PDF maps hosted by PEADD (Pennyrile Area Development District, last updated 2018); official maps are kept at city halls. The county parcel viewer is a Schneider qPublic portal with no public REST endpoint. ArcGIS searches for Muhlenberg zoning, Central City and Kentucky zoning returned no district layer.
